upstream_ruling.b3_contact_model: two separate hard-finger frictional point contacts; force only at each point
upstream_ruling.missing_capability: pure torque about the instantaneous contact chord
upstream_ruling.inference_rule: the sixth constraint is a new synthetic mechanism assumption and shall never be attributed to B3 contact

trigger_contract.selection_rule: first reference sample for which soft_capture_criteria.soft_capture_transient_qualifies is true and all_ledgers_closed is true, with no prior DIAGNOSTIC_FAIL_CLOSED or upstream ABORTED_SAFE state
trigger_contract.interpolation_rule_for_future_solver: locate the earliest predicate transition independently for each integrator; never force the frozen reference timestamp into another integrator

synthetic_snapshot_transform.name: T_PALM_TARGET_SNAPSHOT_SYNTHETIC
synthetic_snapshot_transform.origin: target body-frame origin at target COM
synthetic_snapshot_transform.service_attachment: the coincident snapshot frame rigidly attached to palm after acquisition
synthetic_snapshot_transform.no_pose_snap_rule: the event freezes the current relative pose; it shall never move the target to a nominal transform
synthetic_snapshot_transform.orientation_validity: rotation orthogonality, positive determinant, unit quaternion and deterministic quaternion sign shall satisfy PHASE_B4_NUMERICAL_ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT_V1

attached_subspace.target_twist_mapping: twist_target=A_target_from_palm_snapshot(q)*eta with omega_target=omega_palm and v_target_com=v_palm+omega_palm cross r, r=r_target_com-r_palm

acquisition_impulse_projection.independent_kkt_solution: directly solve block system [[M_minus,-J_bar^T],[J_bar,0]]*[z_plus_kkt;lambda_bar]=[M_minus*z_minus;0] without forming a Schur complement from the reduced path
acquisition_impulse_projection.linear_solver_policy: use Cholesky or symmetric LDL^T only for the reduced SPD system and W_bar audit; solve the symmetric-indefinite block KKT only with pivoted symmetric LDL^T or an equivalent pivoted direct solve; explicit inverse, pinv and lstsq are forbidden for acquisition
acquisition_impulse_projection.required_equivalence: z_plus_reduced and z_plus_kkt agree componentwise within PHASE_B4_NUMERICAL_ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT_V1 native-unit tolerances
acquisition_impulse_projection.required_post_constraint: both native J_c*z_plus=0 and scaled J_bar*z_plus=0

wrench_and_momentum_semantics.constraint_frame_origin: target COM and coincident palm snapshot point at acquisition
wrench_and_momentum_semantics.service_equivalent_wrench_about_palm_ori: [-p;-(ell+r_cross_p)], where r=r_target_com-r_palm; this is one equivalent wrench and r_cross_p shall not be added a second time
wrench_and_momentum_semantics.ordinary_angular_impulse_projection: J_tau_axis_projection=a_chord dot ell; this is not generally the rank5-unreachable scalar
wrench_and_momentum_semantics.synthetic_missing_sixth_wrench_scalar: chi_missing=a_chord dot (ell-r_left cross p)=a_chord dot ell-(a_chord cross r_left) dot p
wrench_and_momentum_semantics.rank5_identity: every two-point hard-finger resultant wrench satisfies chi_missing=0
wrench_and_momentum_semantics.normalized_rank5_unreachable_projection: after independently proving rank(G_bar)=5 with the frozen SVD tolerance, Lambda_missing=(I-G_bar*pinv(G_bar))*Lambda_bar may be used for audit decomposition only; it shall not solve the six-constraint impact
wrench_and_momentum_semantics.attribution: nonzero chi_missing or Lambda_missing is supplied only by the synthetic sixth constraint and is a mechanism requirement, never B3 contact capability

contact_to_constraint_switch.b3_contact_force_after_acquisition: disabled while synthetic constraint is active
contact_to_constraint_switch.reference_anchor_role: B3 hash-bound synthetic reference only; every future integrator recomputes U_left_minus and U_right_minus at its own earliest event
contact_to_constraint_switch.contact_potential_sum: U_contact_minus=U_left_minus+U_right_minus with each side counted exactly once

active_constraint_propagation.primary_architecture: reduced-coordinate rigid target child attached to palm by the frozen synthetic snapshot transform
active_constraint_propagation.mass_matrix: M_attached=L^T*M_combined*L, equivalently reconstructed by summing service bodies plus target child body
active_constraint_propagation.bias: h_attached=L^T*(h_combined+M_combined*L_dot*eta); a fixed-child multibody reconstruction is allowed only if it independently agrees with this expression in every native generalized-effort channel
active_constraint_propagation.contact_geometry: raw left/right gaps continue to be logged but generate no force while constraint is active

release_contract.clearance_rule: both raw contact gaps satisfy g_i>=g_clearance_min>0 and gap rates satisfy gdot_i>=-v_reentry_tol continuously for clearance_dwell_s while all ledgers remain closed
release_contract.clearance_continuity: event-interpolated full dwell; sample endpoints alone are insufficient
release_contract.earliest_eligible_event_rule: t0=t_a+minimum_active_diagnostic_dwell_s; tau_c=inf{tau>=t0: both gap and gap-rate inequalities plus all ledgers hold for every t in [tau,tau+clearance_dwell_s]}; t_r=tau_c+clearance_dwell_s
release_contract.event_selection: remove the constraint at the unique earliest finite t_r; later favorable times are forbidden
release_contract.cross_integrator_removal_event_definitio: compare each integrator's independently located earliest t_r, never a forced shared timestamp
release_contract.release_mapping: at removal q_r, first expand z_before=L(q_r)*eta_minus from the 14D active state, then initialize independent service and target states with z_after=z_before componentwise
release_contract.contact_kernel_after_removal: remain disabled in the B4 main audit branch; raw left/right gaps continue to be evaluated
release_contract.recontact_rule: any post-removal raw gap below g_clearance_min or forbidden closing-rate violation enters DIAGNOSTIC_FAIL_CLOSED_GAP_REENTRY_AFTER_SYNTHETIC_CONSTRAINT_REMOVAL
release_contract.future_contact_reactivation: requires a separate preregistered re-contact state-initialization contract; prohibited in B4 main branch

state_machine.qualification_rule: all event-local and full-trajectory checks must pass; a terminal label alone has zero Gate value

fail_closed_conditions: upstream source hash or byte drift
trigger is not the first qualifying B3 sample
upstream B3 online ledger failure or earlier abort
nonfinite state mass Jacobian transform impulse energy or residual
M_minus or M_attached not symmetric positive definite
rank(L_hat) not 14 or rank(J_hat) not 6 or J_hat*L_hat residual above tolerance
scaled effective mass W_bar not symmetric positive definite
post-acquisition relative twist residual above tolerance
total linear or angular momentum jump beyond native-unit tolerance
contact elastic potential omitted rather than transferred to dissipation
contact force and synthetic constraint simultaneously active
active pose twist momentum or energy ledger violation
release requested before both-gap clearance dwell
nonzero release impulse or velocity jump
post-removal negative raw gap or any contact-kernel reactivation
any forbidden state authorization or claim
